drona_cpuMonitorEnable.name: drona_cpu_monitor
drona_cpuMonitorEnable.label: Monitor CPU
drona_cpuMonitorEnable.help: Collect CPU utilization and memory usage in the background (via ps) while the job runs, viewable as a live chart under Manage.

drona_gpuMonitorEnable.name: drona_gpu_monitor
drona_gpuMonitorEnable.label: Monitor GPU
drona_gpuMonitorEnable.help: Collect GPU utilization/memory usage in the background (via nvidia-smi) while the job runs, viewable as a live chart under Manage.
